name: Carrd
whatYouLose: A visual editor for people who will never open a code editor
Built-in form handling and hosting in one bill
At about $19/year it is already very cheap
prompt:
Build a one-page landing site generator, a Carrd replacement.

Stack: Astro, content in site.yaml, deploys to any static host.
Features:
- Sections composed from site.yaml: hero, features grid, testimonial, pricing, FAQ, email capture, footer.
- 5 visual presets (minimal, bold, editorial, terminal, soft) switched by one key.
- Email capture form posts to a single serverless function that appends to a CSV or forwards to a webhook.
- Responsive down to 320px, accessible color contrast, prefers-reduced-motion respected.
- Generated OG image and favicon from the site title.
Done when: changing site.yaml rebuilds a polished page in under 2 seconds.
notes: Carrd is cheap and good. You replace it to own the code, not to save money.
